user_tasks_completed_ck.name: user_tasks_completed_ck
user_tasks_completed_ck.value: ("user_tasks"."status" = 'completed') = ("user_tasks"."outcome" is not null and "user_tasks"."completed_at" is not null)

workflow_runs_schedule_uq.name: workflow_runs_schedule_uq
workflow_runs_schedule_uq.where: "workflow_runs"."trigger_id" is not null and "workflow_runs"."scheduled_for" is not null

workflow_runs_lease_ck.name: workflow_runs_lease_ck
workflow_runs_lease_ck.value: "workflow_runs"."status" <> 'running' or ("workflow_runs"."lease_owner" is not null and "workflow_runs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
